steps.npc: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! What can I do for you?
This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.

options.text: Where did this Arena come from?

steps.player: Where did this Arena come from?

steps.npc: The original building was excavated by the Varrock Museum a while ago. It dated back to the Second Age!

When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
More recently, the Emir of Al Kharid acquired the Arena and had it renovated to the state it's in now. He's kept me on to handle day-to-day running, though.

steps.player: What would the Emir want to do with a bunch of fight pits?

steps.npc: Something about a rowdy group of match-fixers, so I heard. I think the guards would know more about it than I would.

How do I get a fight?

steps.player: How do I get a fight?

steps.npc: You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.

steps.text: This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Duels or Tournaments.
Once you've found it, click Sign up to sign up to one, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Duel or Tournament, whenever one begins.
Ranked Duels and Tournaments take place on designated worlds, with stats and items provided to you on those worlds.

steps.npc: Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...

steps.text: You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.
On PvP Arena worlds the Arena will supply stats and items for your fight. You'll get to choose your load-out from a menu.
On other worlds, like this one, you must bring your own items, and fight with your own stats.
